text:
Which time period is approximately equal to 24 hours?
A
the time for the Earth to complete one rotation on its axis
B
the time for the Earth to orbit the Sun
C
the time for the Moon to orbit the Earth
D
the time for the Sun to orbit the Earth

options.label: A
options.text: the time for the Earth to complete one rotation on its axis

options.label: B
options.text: the time for the Earth to orbit the Sun

options.label: C

options.label: D
